U.S. House of Representatives voted 232 to 198 to pass the Stop Insider Trading Act, establishing new restrictions on stock purchases by lawmakers while bundling the measure with a federal photo voter ID requirement. 



It faces steep headwinds in the Senate due to the attached voter ID rider and the absence of an outright stock ownership ban.

The Details:

Democratic Opposition & Scope Limits: While 13 Democrats voted in favor alongside Republicans, most opposed the bill for failing to mandate full divestment of existing stock holdings, omitting executive branch officials, and including voter ID restrictions.

Tesla ($TSLA) removed target dates for reaching "volume production" in 2026 across three major hardware lines—the Cybercab, Tesla Semi, and Megapack 3—as well as its Optimus humanoid robot in its Q2 shareholder letter.

The Details:

Proprietary 4680 Cell Delays: Scaling commercial volume specifically depends on the internal manufacturing ramp of Tesla's proprietary 4680 battery cells.
Giga Texas Cybercab Builds: While initial pilot builds of the Cybercab began at Giga Texas in Austin, dedicated assembly lines for the Tesla Semi remain under active construction.
Q2 Earnings Metrics: Net income fell 5% YoY to $1.1 billion, while free cash flow turned negative during the quarter.
